column2: Proclaim the Estado Novo on Earth
The realm is mighty enough to realize Ordem upon the earth. Secular and religious authority will be united in your person, and you will become the temporal head of the Varguist faith.

The promise of the Prophet is no longer merely anticipated. Before the assembled ministers, officers, and people, you proclaim the Estado Novo realized upon the earth. The old separation of sacred direction and secular command ends: both now reside in your person as the supreme representative of Ordem.
Varguists honor tireless work in the service of Ordem and Progresso.
Just rule is understood as the natural expression of Ordem.
Rulers are expected to give alms and provide for the people.
Idleness obstructs the ordered progress of society.
A ruler who hoards wealth rather than giving alms betrays the social duties of office.
Arbitrary rule is a direct assault upon Ordem and gravely discredits a ruler before the faithful.
This ruler has proclaimed Ordem's new earthly kingdom and united secular and religious authority.
